widget_guide.title: Widget / Lock Screen Guide
widget_guide.subtitle: Track your worship from your home screen and lock screen
widget_guide.how_home: How to Add to Home Screen?
widget_guide.how_lock: How to Add to Lock Screen?
widget_guide.tip_desc: Widgets auto-update every hour. The Verse of the Day and Asma ul-Husna widgets show different content each hour.
widget_guide.premium_note: 👑 All widgets are active throughout your Premium subscription.
widget_guide.free_note: ⏳ Widgets are active for 1 hour for free users. Go unlimited with Premium.
widget_guide.ios_note_desc: Lock screen widgets are available on iOS 16 and later. Home screen widgets support iOS 14+.
widget_guide.premium_desc: Go Premium to use all the widgets.
widget_guide.l1d: Unlock your phone but stay on the Lock Screen, then press and hold an empty area.
widget_guide.l2d: Tap the Customize button that appears, then choose Lock Screen.
widget_guide.l3t: Tap the box under the clock
widget_guide.l3d: Tap the empty widget area right below the clock; the widget list opens.
widget_guide.l4d: Find İslami Yoldaş in the list and tap the widget you want.
widget_guide.l5d: Tap Done at the top right, then tap the screen. That's it!
widget_guide.h1d: Press and hold an empty spot until the icons start to jiggle.
widget_guide.h2d: Tap the + button in the top-left corner.
widget_guide.h3d: Type İslami Yoldaş in the search box and select the app.
widget_guide.h4d: Swipe left or right to pick the small or medium size.
widget_guide.h5d: Tap Add Widget, then tap Done at the top right. All set!
widget_guide.preview_lock: This is how the widget looks on your Lock Screen
widget_guide.preview_home: This is how the widget looks on your Home Screen
widget_guide.a1d: Press and hold an empty spot; a small menu appears.
widget_guide.a2d: Choose Widgets from the menu that opens.
widget_guide.a3d: Scroll the widget list to İslami Yoldaş or use the search box.
widget_guide.a4d: Press and hold the widget you want, then drag it to an empty spot on your Home Screen.
widget_guide.a5d: Drag the dots on its edges to resize the widget. All set!
widget_guide.android_note: Lock Screen widgets are only available on iPhone (iOS 16+). On Android, widgets go on the Home Screen.
